meta.title: 审美启发第1期 | 摄影画廊

scenes.title_cn: 内容定位：这是一期「审美启发」系列图…
scenes.title_en: What this is: an aesthetic-inspiration pho…
scenes.context: 基于图文实录图集介绍重构。
sentences: 这是一期审美启发系列的图片画廊。
This is an aesthetic-inspiration photo gallery.
photo gallery（图片画廊）
多看、多拆解、多模仿，是审美提升最快的路径。
Seeing more, breaking down more, imitating more is the fastest path to better taste.
fastest path（最快的路径）
scenes.speak: This is an aesthetic-inspiration photo gallery. Seeing more, breaking down more, imitating more is the fastest path to better taste.

scenes.title_cn: 看图的四个维度：第一，构图——主体放…
scenes.title_en: Four dimensions to read any photo: composi…
sentences: 看图的第一维度是构图：主体放在哪里，留白多少。
First dimension: composition—where the subject sits, how much negative space.
composition（构图）
第二是光线：硬光还是柔光，方向来自哪里。
Second: light—hard or soft, from where.
hard or soft（硬柔光）
第三是色调：冷暖对比还是统一色系。
Third: tone—cool-warm contrast or a unified palette.
unified palette（统一色系）
第四是情绪：这张图想让你感受到什么。
Fourth: mood—what the image wants you to feel.
mood（情绪）
scenes.speak: First dimension: composition—where the subject sits, how much negative space. Second: light—hard or soft, from where. Third: tone—cool-warm contrast or a unified palette. Fourth: mood—what the image wants you to feel.

scenes.title_cn: 学习建议：与其收藏一百张图，不如精读…
scenes.title_en: Study advice: rather than collecting a hun…
scenes.context: 精读优于收藏的练习方法。
sentences: 与其收藏一百张图，不如精读十张图。
Rather than collecting a hundred images, read ten deeply.
read ten deeply（精读十张）
每张图用四维框架拆解一遍，写下你观察到的内容。
Break down each with the four-dimension framework, writing your observations.
four-dimension framework（四维框架）
坚持三十天，你的审美直觉会有肉眼可见的提升。
Persist thirty days and your visual intuition will visibly improve.
visible improvement（肉眼可见的提升）
scenes.speak: Rather than collecting a hundred images, read ten deeply. Break down each with the four-dimension framework, writing your observations. Persist thirty days and your visual intuition will visibly improve.

practice: Read composition, light, tone, and mood.
Break down ten photos deeply, not a hundred.
Thirty days of practice upgrades your eye.
pitfalls: 收藏一百张不如精读十张。
Look at photos only for liking.
Break them into composition, light, tone, mood.
用四维框架拆解，不是只看喜不喜欢。
Expect taste to grow by osmosis.
写下观察，刻意练习才有效。
Imitate after you can read the structure.
shifts: 用 composition（构图）、leading lines（引导线）、negative space（留白）
用 hard or soft（硬柔光）、light direction（光向）、shadow（阴影）
说看照片只会说 look at
用 break down（拆解）、four-dimension framework（四维框架）、visual intuition（审美直觉）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播（图集无口播，场景依据图文实录画面与SVG分析重构）。已校正：审美启发、图片画廊、构图、光线、色调、情绪、引导线、留白、硬柔光、冷暖对比、统一色系、饱和度、精读、四维框架、审美直觉、三十天等。
